main_text.p: 1.Reg.3.magister militiæ Saul regis fuerat, spreto David, Iibaal [?] regis sui filium regem con-stituit. Crebris deinde præliis inter duces regum concursum: pulsus Abner sæpius: Afael [?]{*}fratrem tamen Ioab, qui ex parte David exercitui præcerat, fugiens peremit. Quo dolore postea Ioab, cum se Abner David regi dedisset, jugulari cum præcepit non fine dolore regis, cujus fide cruentaverat. Per idem tempus omnes fere natu majo-2.Reg.5.res Hebræorum publico consensu regnū ei totius gentis detulerunt. nam per septē bet fex menfes [?]annos{b} in Chebron tantum regnaverat, ita tertio rex ungitur, annorum circiter xxx. Allophylos in regnum irruentes, se-2.Reg.6.cundis præliis repulit. Ea tempestate ar-cam Domini, quæ in Cariathiarim opido, 2.Reg.7.ut supra retulimus, erat, in Sion transtulit. Cumque ædificare Domino templum in animo haberet, divinum ei responsum fervari [?]redditum, feminí illius id{*} refervari. Bel-lo deinde Allophylos domuit, Moabi-tas subjugavit, Syriam subegit,{4} stipendi-tol [?]umq; ei impofuit, Auri atque æris ex pre-daimmenfum [?] modum retulit. Bellum 2.Reg.8.deinde adversum{4} Ammonitas ex inju-tributi [?]ria Chanun regis corum exortum, Syris dfilios Ammon.

page.notes: Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Marginal notes Afael, bet fex menfes, fervari, tol, tributi and dfilios Ammon are uncertain readings. The word "daimmenfum" at the end of the line after "ex pre-" is doubtful. "Iibaal" and "feminí" are doubtful. The asterisk and superscript marks (*, 4, b) are reference marks in the text whose matching notes are not clearly printed. Catchword "denuo" is printed at bottom right. Some marginal notes could not be fully confirmed at this scan resolution.
